item.text:
Implemented with `apply_patch` exactly as planned:

- Added `POST /api/signup` to `accountRoutes`, returning 201 with `{token, user}` and converting `UserError` to 400 `{error}`.
- Added `test/signup.test.ts` covering registration, immediate sign-in, validation, and duplicate emails.

`node --test "test/**/*.test.ts"` passed all 9 tests. `npm run typecheck` also passed.

No deviations from the plan.
